rounds.text: The stock of Asston Pharmaceuticals Ltd (544445) is under-appreciated based on the evidence provided. The company's ROE has consistently outperformed its sector benchmark over both 3 and 5 years, with median returns of 26% and 28%, respectively [E19, E20]. Additionally, the stock currently sits at an impressive 89% of its 52-week range, indicating strong upside potential [E5]. Despite a P/E ratio that is slightly higher than the sector average [E6], Asston Pharmaceuticals Ltd's ROCE stands at 17.0%, which is significantly above the sector benchmark [E41]. These metrics suggest that the company has a robust financial performance and growth prospects, warranting further investigation despite its current valuation.
